items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the equivalence of four formulations of purity along a geometric point at source lines 401-421, label lemma-pure-along-X-y, whose proof occupies source lines 423-467. Besides the definitional equivalence of the first two formulations, the proof has two nontrivial directions: it descends an impurity from the spectrum of the etale local ring to an etale neighbourhood by writing that ring as a filtered colimit of the rings of affine etale neighbourhoods and using the limit characterisation of purity, and it ascends an impurity along a locally quasi-finite base change to the local ring, where the strictly henselian hypothesis turns the quasi-finite morphism into a finite one after passing to an open and closed neighbourhood, after which the relative assassin of the pullback and closedness of the map on underlying spaces identify the closure of the image of the impurity with the closure of a point. The counted statement records neither the limit argument nor the strictly henselian finiteness step.
